caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden table with four straight, tapering legs. The wood is shown in rich brown tones with darker, wavy grain patterns on the apron and the sides of the tabletop. The legs are decorated with vertical stripes, green vine or leaf motifs, and occasional yellow diamond shapes. The skirt of the table features oval medallions in gold color, bordered by thin yellow lines. The overall design is symmetrical, with the table being rendered on a plain, off-white background. The drawing is signed in the bottom left corner.
title: Card Table
